fields.title: 📖 The believers will see their Lord
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī and Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Allah will be seen in the Hereafter; the people of Paradise will see Him with their eyes and hear His speech, as He wills and however He wills.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahl as-Sunnah** affirm the ***ruʾyah of Allah in the Hereafter*** as it was transmitted. The **Jahmiyyah** rejected such texts by denial and reinterpretation; the imams affirmed them without **takyīf**, without **tashbīh** and without **taʿṭīl**.
